assumptions_and_limitations: Default Floor Height: 10.0 ft floor-to-floor assumption.
Structural Steel: Estimated at provisional rate of 4.0 kg/sq ft of built-up area. Subject to certified structural engineer's RCC design drawings & Bar Bending Schedule (BBS).
Concrete Mix: M20 grade (1:1.5:3) assumed for slabs, beams, columns, and foundations with standard dry volume conversion factor of 1.54.
Wall Construction: 9-inch exterior boundary walls and 4.5-inch interior partition walls with modular red clay bricks (13.5 bricks/cu ft with 5% handling wastage).
Plastering: 12-15mm cement-sand plaster (1:6 on walls, 1:4 on ceilings) across all exposed masonry surfaces.
Flooring: 7% cutting and edge wastage allowance included on net indoor usable floor area. Outdoor areas (balconies/terraces) calculated separately with 8% wastage.
Soil & Foundation: Assumes standard hard morrum / soil condition with isolated footing depth of 5 ft. Rocky, loose black cotton soil or deep pile foundations will require structural revisions.
Location Rates: Benchmark material & labor rates sourced for Hyderabad, Telangana (2026). Sourced as illustrative planning benchmarks; user editable for local quotations.
